title: Bartleby the Scrivener: A Story of Wall Street
author: Herman Melville
summary: A Wall Street lawyer hires a copyist named Bartleby, who one day answers every request with the same polite refusal. The narrator is baffled by the quiet resistance of his employee.
readIf: you like short, strange classics that leave you pondering what they mean.
skipIf: you want a story that explains itself or resolves neatly.
